quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC of 13.27% (reaching 19.59% in FY25) reflects solid look-through capital efficiency across world-class Swedish industrials (AB Volvo, Sandvik) and Handelsbanken. 5-10Y forward growth of 7.5% reflects industrial equipment volume (2.5%), pricing power (2.0%), automation/mining electrification mix (1.5%), and portfolio dividend reinvestment (1.5-2.0%). Fortress holdco balance sheet with LTV of ~3%, net debt of SEK 5.9B (0.17x earnings), and interest coverage of 217.5x.
